chapter.title: Power and Logistics
subtitle: Power on a wire, goods on a shelf.
What RF is, how it travels, and how a workshop stops being forty chests.

hover: Every machine in the pack counts in it.

images.hover: Two out of every copper plate.
Four wire round an iron spool.

hover: Deep, and labelled on the front.

images.hover: It reaches every drawer within twelve blocks.
The end of the duct that pushes.
Upgrades go in a row along the bottom.

quests.title: Wind Four RF Coils
quests.subtitle: One gold ingot, two redstone, done.
description: &bRF&r is the pack's one unit of power. Every dynamo makes it, every duct carries it, every machine spends it, and the number on a cell is the whole story.
Craft four &aRF Coils&r. A coil is the piece that lets a block hold power, move it, or make it.
Done these in &6Thermal&r already? They tick on sight — this chapter is really the four Create Addition quests and the shelving. Skip down.

quests.title: Build an Energy Cell
quests.subtitle: A battery with two dials on it.
description: Craft an &aEnergy Cell&r and set its two dials: how fast power goes in, and how fast it comes back out.
Put one between whatever makes power and everything that wants it. Bram runs a cell to the inn in Act III, step 10.

quests.title: Lay Thirty-Two Energy Ducts
quests.subtitle: No loss, no settings, any distance.
description: Craft thirty-two &aEnergy Ducts&r and run a line from the cell to a machine. They join up on sight and lose nothing over any length.
One line out of the mill lit four lamp posts in Act II, step 15.

quests.title: Cap a Duct With a Servo
quests.subtitle: Power ducts and item ducts, same attachment.
description: Craft two &aServo Attachments&r and put one on the duct face touching the machine you want fed. A bare duct shares power out evenly; a servo makes that end push.

The same attachment goes on an &aItem Duct&r — the item-carrying twin of the energy duct, four to a craft off lead and glass. Servo on the chest end, bare duct on the machine end, and ore walks itself into the Pulverizer.
A &aFilter Attachment&r on the same face picks which items travel. Eight of them come with the Works grid in Act IV.
Oda sells sixteen at the counter if you would rather not make them.

quests.title: Build a Rolling Mill
quests.subtitle: Plates in one side, wire out the far side.
description: Craft a &aRolling Mill&r and drive it off a shaft. It flattens ingots into plates and rolls plates into wire, which no bench recipe will do for you.
The rotation comes off the water wheel in the &6Create&r chapter.

quests.title: Roll Sixteen Wire and Wind a Spool
quests.subtitle: Four wire round a plain iron spool.
description: Feed copper plates through the mill for &aCopper Wire&r, then wrap four of them round a &aSpool&r.
Spools are the winding inside every generator and motor after this.

quests.title: Build an &aAlternator&r
quests.subtitle: Rotation goes in. RF comes out.
description: Set the mechanical crafters out and build an Alternator: iron plates, two spools and a capacitor. Give its shaft rotation and it pushes &bRF&r out the flat face.
The crafters are in the &6Create&r chapter. Faster shaft, more power.

quests.title: Build an Electric Motor
quests.subtitle: The same trade, run backwards.
description: Build an &aElectric Motor&r on the crafters. Feed it RF and it turns a shaft at whatever speed you dial in, whether or not the stream is running.
A dry August stops the water wheel. This does not.

quests.title: Hang Wire Between Two Connectors
quests.subtitle: Power across a gap with nothing in it.
description: Craft six &aConnectors&r, stick one on each machine, then right-click the first with a spool and the second after it. The wire strings itself across.
Cheaper than ducting the mill race, and you can see where the power goes.

quests.title: Put Up Four Drawers and a Controller
quests.subtitle: One wall instead of a row of chests.
description: Power was half the job. Build four &aOak Drawers&r and a &aDrawer Controller&r, and set the controller where its faces touch the bank.
It fills and empties every drawer in reach at once. Act II, step 14 fits the workshop this way.

quests.title: Slot Two Iron Upgrades Into a Drawer
quests.subtitle: Two iron, six sticks, one blank template.
description: Craft two &aIron Storage Upgrades&r from a blank template and drop them into the drawer's upgrade slots. Each one multiplies what that drawer holds.
Iron, then gold, then diamond, then emerald and obsidian.

quests.title: Stack-Upgrade a Barrel
quests.subtitle: Sixty-four to the slot, then more.
description: Build a &aSophisticated Barrel&r and slot a &aStack Upgrade&r along its bottom row. Every slot in that barrel then holds a multiple of what it did.
The same row takes a magnet, a filter, a furnace and a hopper.

quests.title: Wire Every Barrel to One Screen
quests.subtitle: A storage controller and two links.
description: Place a &aStorage Controller&r against one barrel, then put a &aStorage Link&r on any box too far away to touch it. Open the controller and every linked box reads as one list.
This is the small version of what the &6Storage Network&r chapter does with a cable.

rewards.title: Power and Logistics
rewards.description: Next: Act II step 14 fits the workshop with drawers, and Act III step 10 runs the first duct to the inn.
